definitions.explanation: any work that has been published and distributed, including books, journals, and periodicals

examples.japanese: ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究所|けんきゅうしょ}→研究所：03054_kenkyuusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{閲覧|えつらん}できる→閲覧する：18280_etsuransuru⟧。

examples.english: Government publications can be obtained at the National Diet Library.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{刊行|かんこう}→刊行：02788_kankou⟧ (publication/issuing) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing/object). A formal term covering all types of published materials. The suffix ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ creates concrete nouns from abstract concepts, as in ⟦{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}→印刷物：24581_insatsubutsu⟧ (printed matter) and ⟦{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}→出版物：15497_shuppanbutsu⟧ (published materials).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}: government publication
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}: periodical, regular publication
- {刊行物|かんこうぶつ}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: list of publications
- {刊行物|かんこうぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue a publication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}→出版物：15497_shuppanbutsu⟧: published material — very similar, but ⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧ emphasizes commercial publishing
- ⟦{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}→印刷物：24581_insatsubutsu⟧: printed matter — broader, includes anything printed
- ⟦{書籍|しょせき}→書籍：04203_shoseki⟧: books — specifically books, not periodicals or reports
